title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1970-04-15
source: sdb> Master Reel> Cassette> Dat> CD

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording of the legendary 4/15/70 Winterland show, highlighted by Pigpen’s “This Is A Man’s World”, a smoking “Dancin’ In The Streets” and a ferocious Drums‑Jam segment.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this April 1970 Winterland performance, calling it a tight, energetic set with standout moments from Pigpen on “This Is A Man’s World” and “Turn On Your Love Light”, plus a scorching “Dancin’ In The Streets”. The soundboard source is praised as crystal‑clear and well‑balanced, making the intricate jams – especially the Drums > Jam sequence and “Cryptical Envelopment” – shine. Overall the show is viewed as a quintessential early‑70s Dead experience.

ai_rating.rationale: The overwhelming majority of reviews are 4–5 stars, lauding both the musical performance and the soundboard quality; only a single negative comment appears, so the combined show (70%) + recording (30%) rating is very high.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple reviewers note a "Super 70' Soundboard" mix that is crisp, clear and well‑balanced; no complaints about dropouts or muddiness were recorded.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert is described as relaxed and flowing, with the band moving 'around the fire'—tight acoustic gems early on followed by a high‑energy jam that builds into a powerful Drums‑Jam climax.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Mentioned fondly in reminiscences of the venue (“Jerry and Pig”) and praised for his presence, though no specific guitar details were given.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen’s keyboard/vocal magic on "This Is A Man's World" and "Turn On Your Lovelight" is highlighted as a key highlight of the night.
band_member_comments.Drums: The drum‑jam segment receives glowing praise for being 'primal', 'insane' and comparable to Santana’s intensity.
